description: Change field values on an existing submission, or mark it read/unread. Only the fields you pass are changed. Formstack: PUT /submissions/{submissionId}.

encryption_password.description: Only for forms with encryption enabled: the form's encryption password, sent as the X-FS-Encryption-Password header.

value.description: The field value as an object, shaped by field type: text/email/number/phone/textarea/datetime/radio → {"value":"..."}; name → {"first":"...","last":"..."} (also prefix, middle, initial, suffix); address → {"address","address2","city","state","zip","country"}; checkbox/select → {"subvalues":[{"subvalue":"..."}]}. Use formstack_list_form_fields for field IDs and types.

read.description: Mark the submission read (true) or unread (false).

name: formstack_update_submission
title: Update a submission
